header: Ordered stages, each with a state and a percentage
lead: State comes from the semantic key on the child record, progress from the percentage typed in its value. Both are editorial statements, so date the band in the note.
note: A stage at 0 % reads as not started and a stage at 100 % as finished, in figures — the marker colour only repeats what the percentage already says.

metrics.title: A finished stage
metrics.text: Marked done, and the bar is full.

metrics.title: A running stage
metrics.text: The detail line is where the next date belongs.

metrics.title: A stage that has not started
metrics.text: An empty bar and a hollow marker.
